# LocalHouseLLM

> LocalHouseLLM is an AI company building local-first AI infrastructure and the desktop applications that run on it. Its infrastructure is AICL (an internal communication layer), ORCHA (orchestration and agent execution), Nomi (memory) and Anvira Runtime (a shared local AI service). Its applications are Anvira, a local-first agent workspace, and Anvira Notes, a notes and study app.

Everything on localhousellm.com is open to search engines and AI crawlers for indexing, retrieval and citation. Each page below is served as complete HTML (no JavaScript needed to read it).

## Products

- [Anvira](https://localhousellm.com/anvira): Free local-first AI chat and coding agent for Windows. Runs GGUF models through llama.cpp on the user's GPU, works on project folders, and shows every agent change as a per-file diff that can be undone. Optional cloud providers. Current release 1.0.1.
- [Anvira Notes](https://localhousellm.com/anvira-notes): Free local-first notes and study app for Windows. Notion-style pages, two-way Google Docs and Notion sync, a local lecture recorder (whisper.cpp), offline OCR, and a study coach with FSRS flashcards, quizzes and exams generated from the user's notes. Current release 1.2.2.
